items.description: WELCOME TO THE CHAOSForget complex strategy. Forget "fair play." Here the rule is simple: Dash or get Destroyed.DASH DUELS is a high-speed party game where physics is your best friend... and your worst enemy. Gather up to 4 friends (or enemies) on the couch, pick your Skin, and prepare for the screaming.ONE HIT = ONE KILLThere are no health bars. If you get touched by a Dash, it's over.Physical Combat: If two players Dash at the same time, a CLASH happens and both fly backwards.Ricochet: Missed the attack? Watch out. You might bounce off the wall and fly straight into your death.Shields & Mind Games: Use the shield to tank a hit and watch the look of despair on your opponent's face.FEATURES OF CHAOS4-Player Local Multiplayer: The classic couch chaos.Online via Remote Play Together: Invite up to 4 friends online to play as if they were in your house. The best part? Only one person needs to buy the game.AI Bots (From Noob to Sigma): No friends around? Train against our Bots ranging from "Easy Target" to "Mathematical Nightmare."Game Modes: Free For All (FFA) or Teams (2v2) for when you want to blame someone else for the loss.Broken Power-Ups: Super Speed, Shields, and Infinite Turbo to turn the tide.STYLE & PERSONALITYThis isn't a generic game. It’s a game bathed in Neon, Cyberpunk, and Internet culture.Skin System: Unlock visuals by winning matches.Visual Feedback: The screen shakes, the game freezes (Hit-stop), and the winner is crowned with the energy they deserve. items.description: Mask of Dead 2: Shadow of Pelagius is a JRPG with an active combat system. A lot of time has passed since the first Adamant War the reapers were able to recover from the damage they received and restore Purgatory, but not for long... Riom Ruri, the son of the High Reaper, has just finished training and has already received his first task - to scout the surrounding area with a small squad of other reapers. But everything does not go according to plan and Riom is forced to face the mistakes of his brothers in the past and save Purgatory from complete destruction.Tactical component of battles:- The frequency of the turn depends on the speed parameter, both for the player and for the enemies. During battles, the speed can be controlled by buffs/debuffs.- The combat system involves cooldowns, delays in enemy attacks, dodging, counterattacking and the ability to stun, completely canceling an attack of any kind. Competently combined skills allow you to control the battle, but be careful - opponents can use the same techniques as you.- EX-scale. A saving straw. For each blow dealt to the enemy, you get a small increase in all parameters up to +20%. But keep in mind that for each missed blow the scale will fall, down to 0%.Plot features:- The game has 7 endings.- Movement around the world is conditionally open. In most chapters, it is possible to go back and finish everything you consider necessary, or to be distracted from the main plot by side activities.Game features:- Non-linear pumping. When the time comes to strengthen Riom`s, a window for selecting skills and parameters will open for you. For each victory you receive Essence, for which you can strengthen any parameter you want. items.description: Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey is a vast and intricate multiplayer game that takes players on an unforgettable journey through a captivating world filled with magic, mystery, and adventure. At the start of the game, players create their own unique character, selecting from a range of classes including warrior, ranger, and mage. Each class offers a different play style and set of abilities, allowing players to tailor their character to their own preferences and play style. Once players have created their character, they are free to explore the world of Legendary Realms, taking on quests and challenges as they go. Quests can range from simple tasks like delivering items or defeating low-level enemies, to more complex missions that require strategic thinking and teamwork. As players progress through the game, they earn rewards and level up, improving their character's stats and unlocking new abilities. They can also purchase equipment from shops and vendors, including weapons, armor, and magical artifacts, which can be used to enhance their combat abilities and increase their chances of success. One of the key features of Legendary Realms is its multiplayer component. Players can team up with others to take on quests and challenges together, combining their skills and abilities for greater success. Additionally, the game offers a robust social system that allows players to communicate with one another, make friends, and form guilds. Beyond its engaging gameplay and multiplayer features, Legendary Realms boasts a rich and immersive world that is sure to captivate players. From towering mountains and dense forests to bustling cities and mysterious ruins, the game's world is filled with detail and nuance, making it feel alive and vibrant. Overall, Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey is an incredible adventure that offers endless possibilities for exploration, questing, and combat. Whether you're a fan of fantasy games, multiplayer games, or both, this game is sure to provide hours of entertainment and excitement. items.description: In a cruel geometric world where treacherous Circles rule supreme, you are one of the last brave Squares to challenge their entire system! Get ready for endless deaths and comebacks, because only through dozens of defeats will you overcome hordes of enemies: endless hordes of red Circles; swift white Circles; purple sniper Circles and other adherents of the BigCircle. Every mistake you make will cost you your life, but every restart will strengthen your resolve.Your mission is to save your kin! A green Square is languishing in the dungeon, an ally guarded by mysterious and terrible Circles from which no one has ever escaped alive. To win, use your granted skills - speed, shield, spikes, and most importantly, get a cannon to kill Mugs in packs. But most importantly, bring her back, the pink Square of your dreams, trapped in the heart of the Bolshekrug citadel. The giant Mandala of the Absolute awaits the final battle - its super-laser attacks will incinerate you in an instant if you don't master the evasions to automatism.You'll have to squeeze everything out of yourself: jump jewelry between spikes, counterattack into micro windows of vulnerability, use the environment as a weapon. Forget about easy victories - just for the hundredth time, memorizing every pixel of the trajectories, you will break the last circle of tyranny. Will you save your friends? Will you set love free? Can you prove that angles are stronger than circles? Only your perseverance will give the answer.This game will give you an idea of what hardcore is in its purest form. You will find 60 levels of endless deaths and attempts to gain the upper hand in multi-genre levels. Only the strongest will collect all the achievements. Good luck!Key FeaturesAttack, defend and use the environment of the levels to hold out until the end and win.There are many different levels by genre and strategy.Lots of random enemy options.There are many control options that you can dive into.Hardcore at the highest level.
